{{Quote|Master Kenobi, meet the mighty Bear Clan.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Novel">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>}}
The '''Bear Clan''' was one of the many [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|clans]] that prospective young [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiates]] were placed in when they first began to learn the ways of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Students placed within this clan were chosen for their foreseen courage and bravery by their fosterers, who looked into each child's future so as to find the right clan to place them in.<ref name="TJP" />

Consisting of about twenty hopeful Jedi, the clan moved through the [[Jedi academy]]'s rigorous test together, forming bonds and support systems that were designed to help in the progression from Initiate to [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. Overseen by a particular sponsor, each clan was first met with simple lessons intended to serve as the basis for future instruction. Once all of the courses at the academy were completed, each member of the clan faced the [[Initiate Trials/Legends|Trials]]; a series of test used to determine what they had retained. If the student passed, their time in the clan was over and they most likely went on to become a Padawan. If a student failed to pass the final trials, they were reassigned to the [[Jedi Service Corps/Legends|Jedi Service Corps]] or asked to leave the Order completely.<ref name="TJP" />

During the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] sponsored a specific year of the Bear Clan, passing down his knowledge accumulated over his long lifespan. After the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] saw to it that the Bear Clan was disbanded during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Several decades later, the [[New Jedi Order|reformed]] Jedi Order did not reestablish the Bear Clan; though [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] did continue the use of the clan system following the [[Dark Nest Crisis]].<ref name="TJP" />

[[File:FullBearclan.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Fourteen members of the Bear Clan.]]
